# Medisave UK

> > UK supplier of medical equipment, healthcare furniture, and clinical workwear for NHS and private healthcare facilities.

Medisave UK is an ISO9001 and ISO14001 certified medical supplies retailer offering products from leading brands including Sunflower, Alexandra, Prestige, Nonin, and Glamox Luxo. The company specializes in medical furniture, diagnostic equipment, and professional healthcare clothing for clinical environments.

## Key Topics

- Medical Furniture
- Healthcare Equipment
- Clinical Workwear
- Sunflower Medical
- Alexandra Workwear
- NHS Supplies
- MHRA Compliance
- ISO9001 & ISO14001 Certified
- Examination Lights
- Phlebotomy Chairs
- Patient Seating
- Pulse Oximeters
- Medical Stools
- Autoclavable Footwear
- Ergonomic Seating
